camel_example: aliyun gpdb CreateDatabase --region cn-hangzhou --Owner testadb --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --DatabaseName test01
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb create-database --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --database-name test01 --owner testadb --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDatabase

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database.

Only contains letters, digits, and underscores (_).
Must start with a letter.
Up to 63 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称，限制如下：
只能包含字母，数字和下划线。
必须以字母开头。
长度不能超过63个字符
parameters.name: database_name

parameters.help_en:
The character set.

For more information about the value range, see Document [https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/multibyte.html](url).

Default value: UTF-8
parameters.help_zh:
字符集。

取值范围可以参考文档  [https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/multibyte.html](url)

默认为 UTF8
parameters.name: character_set_name

parameters.help_en:
Database locale parameter (specifies string comparison/sorting rules).



The locale must be compatible with the character set specified by the CharacterSetName parameter.

Valid values for the Collate field: You can execute the SELECT DISTINCT collname FROM pg_collation; statement to obtain the field value. The default value is en_US.utf8
parameters.help_zh:
数据库区域设置参数，指定字符串比较/排序规则。

语言环境必须与 CharacterSetName 参数设置的字符集兼容。
Collate 取值：可通过SELECT DISTINCT collname FROM pg_collation; 命令查询获取，不配置时默认为 en_US.utf8
parameters.name: collate

parameters.help_en:
Database locale parameter (defines character classification/case conversion rules).



The locale must be compatible with the character set specified by the CharacterSetName parameter.

You can execute the SELECT DISTINCT collctype FROM pg_collation; statement to obtain the field value. The default value is en_US.utf8
parameters.help_zh:
数据库区域设置参数，指定字符分类/大小写转换规则。

语言环境必须与 CharacterSetName 参数设置的字符集兼容。
可通过SELECT DISTINCT collctype FROM pg_collation; 命令查询获取，不配置时默认为 en_US.utf8
parameters.name: ctype

parameters.help_en:
The owner of the table.

Only contains lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).
Must start with a lowercase letter and end with a lowercase letter or a digit.
Cannot start with gp.
Must be 2 to 16 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
表的拥有者。

由小写字母，数字，下划线组成。

以小写字母开头，小写字母或数字结尾。

不能以gp 开头。

长度为2~16 个字符
parameters.name: owner

parameters.example: A user management database storing customer profiles.
parameters.help_en:
The description of the database.

Must start with a letter.
Cannot start with http:// or https://.
Only contains letters, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and digits.
Must be 2 to 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
数据库描述。

以中文、英文字母开头。

不能以http://或https://开头。

可以包含中文、英文字符、“_”、“-”、数字。

长度为2~256 个字符
parameters.name: description
